chain.title: Ripe for the Picking
chain.desc: Wild Tomatoes generate in plains and forests; break them to start a tomato supply.

chain.title: Seeds of a Bistro
chain.desc: Tomato Seeds are crafted from a single tomato and replanted on farmland.

chain.title: Salad Days Begin
chain.desc: Tomatoes are the base crop behind Candlelight's soups, sauces and salads.

chain.title: Leaf It To Me
chain.desc: Lettuce grows from wild lettuce patches and anchors every green plate on the menu.

chain.title: Pot Luck
chain.desc: The Cooking Pot is built from copper ingots and a wooden shovel; it handles the mod's simmered dishes.

chain.title: Pan-demonium
chain.desc: The Cooking Pan is copper and sticks, and it sears everything the pot cannot.

chain.title: Churn of Events
chain.desc: A milk bucket worked in the crafting grid yields Butter, the fat behind most pan recipes.

chain.title: Say Cheese
chain.desc: Milk plus a water bottle curdles into Mozzarella, the cheese used across Candlelight's salads and pastas.

chain.title: Knead to Know
chain.desc: Wheat and a water bottle press together into Dough, the start of the pasta line.

chain.title: Rolling in the Deep Pot
chain.desc: Dough cooked in the pot becomes Raw Pasta, ready for any sauce you can build.

chain.title: Souper Star
chain.desc: Tomatoes, sugar and a bowl simmer into Tomato Soup, itself an ingredient in richer dishes.

chain.title: Garden Variety
chain.desc: Carrot, potato and tomato on a bowl make the Plate full of Vegetables, the base for both chicken dinners.

chain.title: Steak Your Claim
chain.desc: Beef seared in the pan with butter becomes Candlelight's own Cooked Beef, a cut above the campfire version.

chain.title: Sauce Boss
chain.desc: Tomato soup and cooked beef reduce in the pan into Bolognese, the mod's workhorse sauce.

chain.title: Fungi to Be With
chain.desc: Mushrooms, butter and milk cook down into a creamy Mushroom Soup.

chain.title: Layers of Ambition
chain.desc: Bolognese, pasta and cheese stack in the pot into a full Lasagna.

chain.title: Twirl of Approval
chain.desc: Pasta tossed with bolognese and cheese plates up as Pasta with Bolognese.

chain.title: Alfredo and Ready
chain.desc: Pasta, chicken and a full spread of effect ingredients make Chicken Alfredo in the pan.

chain.title: Dressed to Grill
chain.desc: The Chefs Jacket is stitched from white and black wool; the rest of the whites finish the uniform.

chain.title: The Whole Shebang, En Croute
chain.desc: Beef Wellington wraps bolognese and mushroom soup in dough in the pan, and it is Candlelight's showpiece plate.

notes: Chain derived from data/candlelight/recipes: the pot_cooking and pan_cooking recipe types are the whole progression spine, with dough/pasta and butter/mozzarella as the two intermediate branches that meet at Beef Wellington. Ids verified against assets/candlelight/models/item stems cross-checked with en_us.json keys and jar recipe outputs. Items whose lang key carries a _block suffix (beef_wellington, lasagne, pork_ribs, lettuce_tomato) and tomato_mozzarella_salad (lang key block.candlelight.tomato_mozzarella_block) were kept because the jar's own recipes emit those exact item ids. Partial-eaten model variants (*_1, *_2, *_3), plus faucet, toast, tomato_sauce and wine_glass, are model-only leftovers with no lang entry and no recipe output, so they were dropped.
